title: Two Verbatim Storm Paragraph Repair Candidates

scenes.title: Original08a-p1
lines: We can check a branch's meaning against actual features. Against the Storm is a settlement game where resources are used to build structures and residents are assigned work. We are viewing a developer demonstration from 2024.

scenes.title: Original08a-p4
lines: In our outline, housing and resource production are sibling features, with each building's conditions under its appropriate branch. For a mine or hut still under construction, verifying the result remains an open question.
